entry.content: ... that the Praga E-55 was abandoned due to the Czech aircraft industry being directed to concentrate on licensed production of Soviet aircraft?

entry.title: BLKBOK (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that pianist BLKBOK has composed works based on the murder of George Floyd, the Little Rock Nine, and The Negro Motorist Green Book?

entry.title: James Mustapic (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that for television, James Mustapic set his mother up on a date with David Seymour, who will soon be the New Zealand deputy prime minister?

entry.title: debris fallout (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that debris fallout from a violent 2011 tornado included a photograph found 353 km (219 mi) downstream from its origin?

entry.title: John A. Tibbits (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that John A. Tibbits and his law firm partner served as consecutive U.S. consuls to Bradford, England?

entry.title: wuju (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that the Chinese theatre dance known as wuju blends influences of ballet and traditional opera?

entry.title: a hockey line (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that a hockey line named after That '70s Show helped the Los Angeles Kings win their second Stanley Cup?
